title: What Art Does For Your Brain

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: The Old Testament tells the story of King Saul,
sentences.zh: 《旧约》中讲述了扫罗王的故事，

sentences.en: a ruler who was frequently gripped by waves of anguish and despair.
sentences.zh: 他是一位经常被痛苦和绝望折磨的统治者。

sentences.en: When Saul was afflicted by such torments,
sentences.zh: 当扫罗深受这种折磨时，

sentences.en: his advisors didn't always call for a physician or a prieSt.
sentences.zh: 他的顾问们并不总是求助于医生或祭司。

sentences.en: Instead, they summoned a young shepherd named David,
sentences.zh: 相反，他们会召来一位名叫大卫的年轻牧童，

sentences.en: known for his skill at playing the lyre.
sentences.zh: 他以擅长弹奏竖琴而闻名。

sentences.en: As the music began to play, King Saul's mind would settle
sentences.zh: 当音乐响起，扫罗王的心绪就会平静下来，

sentences.en: and his mood would lift.
sentences.zh: 情绪也会随之好转。

sentences.en: For centuries, stories like this have been treated as legend,
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，这类故事一直被视为传说，

sentences.en: poetic, symbolic, even mystical.
sentences.zh: 充满诗意、象征意义，甚至带有神秘色彩。

sentences.en: But do they point to something real?
sentences.zh: 但它们是否指向某种真实存在的东西呢？

sentences.en: Today, a growing body of scientific research suggests that music,
sentences.zh: 如今，越来越多的科学研究表明，音乐、

sentences.en: painting, dance, and storytelling do far more than entertain us.
sentences.zh: 绘画、舞蹈和讲故事的作用远不止娱乐我们。

sentences.en: They calm our nervous systems, reshape our emotions,
sentences.zh: 它们能平复我们的神经系统，重塑我们的情绪，

sentences.en: and even influence our physical health.
sentences.zh: 甚至影响我们的身体健康。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, and in a companion story on Hidden Brain Plus,
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》，以及《隐藏的大脑 Plus》中的配套故事，

sentences.en: why the arts are no luxury, but rather a vital form of medicine for the mind.
sentences.zh: 将探讨为何艺术不是奢侈品，而是心灵的一剂良药。

sentences.en: Think about the last time a piece of music stopped you in your tracks,
sentences.zh: 回想一下，上一次有一段音乐让你驻足聆听，

sentences.en: or a novel kept you up late into the night,
sentences.zh: 或者一本小说让你深夜不忍释卷，

sentences.en: or a painting made you feel something you couldn't quite put into words.
sentences.zh: 又或者一幅画作让你产生了一种难以言表的感受，是在什么时候？

sentences.en: Why do these experiences feel so powerful?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些体验会如此震撼人心？

sentences.en: For a long time, scientists didn't have a clear answer.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间以来，科学家们都没有明确的答案。

sentences.en: The arts seemed too subjective, too personal, to study in any systematic way.
sentences.zh: 艺术似乎太主观、太个人化，无法进行系统性的研究。

sentences.en: But that's starting to change.
sentences.zh: 但这种情况正在改变。

sentences.en: At University College London, psychobiologist Daisy Fancourt has found that these moments
sentences.zh: 在伦敦大学学院，心理生物学家黛西·范库特发现，这些时刻

sentences.en: are not just meaningful, they're measurable,
sentences.zh: 不仅意义非凡，而且是可以衡量的，

sentences.en: and they can play a crucial role in our emotional and psychological well-being.
sentences.zh: 它们可以在我们的情感和心理健康中发挥至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: Daisy Fancourt, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 黛西·范库特，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: It's lovely to be with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能与你交流。

sentences.en: Daisy, as a young woman, you were very involved in music, singing and playing the piano.
sentences.zh: 黛西，你年轻时就非常热爱音乐，唱歌和弹钢琴。

sentences.en: What did you notice about the emotional and psychological effects
sentences.zh: 你当时注意到了音乐和艺术对你以及你的朋友们

sentences.en: that music and the arts had on you and your friends?
sentences.zh: 产生了怎样的情感和心理影响？

sentences.en: I feel really lucky because I was born into a family of professional musicians,
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己很幸运，因为我出生在一个职业音乐家家庭，

sentences.en: so the arts were just so much a part of my day-to-day upbringing.
sentences.zh: 所以艺术是我日常成长过程中不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: I don't think I really reflected on what a privilege that is,
sentences.zh: 我不认为我当时真正意识到，在那么小的年纪就能接触到这些，

sentences.en: to have that kind of exposure at such a young age.
sentences.zh: 是一种多么大的特权。

sentences.en: I mean, I remember so clearly that if ever I felt stressed or worried about anything
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我清楚地记得，如果我在青少年时期

sentences.en: as a teenager, I used to go and play the piano just sort of instinctively,
sentences.zh: 感到压力或担忧，我就会本能地去弹钢琴，

sentences.en: and I knew that was something that would help me.
sentences.zh: 我知道那能帮到我。

sentences.en: And I certainly have noticed that a lot of the relationships,
sentences.zh: 而且我确实注意到，我早年建立的许多关系，

sentences.en: the friendships that I built early on,
sentences.zh: 那些友谊，

sentences.en: they came through playing music with friends,
sentences.zh: 都是通过和朋友们一起玩音乐建立起来的，

sentences.en: being in orchestras or bands or being involved in musical theatre.
sentences.zh: 比如参加管弦乐队、乐队，或者参与音乐剧。

sentences.en: So I think it was a lot more fundamental and foundational to me
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，它对我来说比我当时所意识到的

sentences.en: than I necessarily appreciated at that young age.
sentences.zh: 要更加基础和重要。

sentences.en: I understand, Daisy, that while you were in college,
sentences.zh: 黛西，我了解到你在大学期间，

sentences.en: you began working in a paediatric hospital.
sentences.zh: 开始在一家儿科医院工作。

sentences.en: Tell me about this work, where it was and what you did.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说这份工作吧，它在哪里，你都做了些什么？

sentences.en: It was an incredible programme that was open to students at Oxford University,
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常棒的项目，面向牛津大学的学生开放，

sentences.en: where I was studying.
sentences.zh: 也就是我当时就读的学校。

sentences.en: And alongside your studies,
sentences.zh: 在学习之余，

sentences.en: you could train to go and deliver arts programmes in hospitals.
sentences.zh: 你可以接受培训，去医院开展艺术项目。

sentences.en: And it was something I just jumped at immediately,
sentences.zh: 我当时毫不犹豫地抓住了这个机会，

sentences.en: because I was still fascinated by science and medicine
sentences.zh: 因为我一直对科学和医学很着迷，

sentences.en: and keen to find a way to blend the two.
sentences.zh: 并渴望找到一种将两者结合的方法。

sentences.en: So we received training and then worked in paediatric hospital wards
sentences.zh: 我们接受了培训，然后在儿科病房工作，

sentences.en: doing singing workshops with the children.
sentences.zh: 为孩子们举办歌唱工作坊。

sentences.en: And I was just completely blown away by the impact that I saw the singing having.
sentences.zh: 我当时完全被我所看到的歌唱带来的影响震撼了。

sentences.en: I kind of expected it to be a nice bit of entertainment.
sentences.zh: 我原本以为这只是一种不错的娱乐活动。

sentences.en: But actually, I was seeing directly that singing with children
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我亲眼看到，与那些

sentences.en: who were really anxious and crying and distressed
sentences.zh: 非常焦虑、哭闹和痛苦的孩子们一起唱歌，

sentences.en: would stop them crying and would actually completely calm them down.
sentences.zh: 能让他们停止哭泣，并完全平静下来。

sentences.en: And I saw these amazing interactions between patients and their siblings,
sentences.zh: 我还看到了患者和他们的兄弟姐妹之间那些奇妙的互动，

sentences.en: that actually music was providing this form of emotional and social connection for them,
sentences.zh: 音乐实际上为他们提供了一种情感和社交连接的方式，

sentences.en: even in this very challenging and kind of often inhumane kind of environments of the hospital.
sentences.zh: 即使是在医院这种充满挑战、有时甚至显得有些冷酷的环境中。

sentences.en: So I was actually able to witness the benefits
sentences.zh: 所以我确实亲眼见证了音乐所带来的益处，

sentences.en: I hadn't really appreciated that music could have.
sentences.zh: 而这些益处我之前并没有真正意识到。

sentences.en: I understand that on one occasion,
sentences.zh: 我了解到有一次，

sentences.en: you observed a premature baby in the hospital
sentences.zh: 你在医院观察到一个早产儿，

sentences.en: who was crying inconsolably and refusing to eat.
sentences.zh: 他哭闹不止，拒绝进食。

sentences.en: Tell me that story.
sentences.zh: 讲讲那个故事吧。

sentences.en: We were working in NICU,
sentences.zh: 当时我们在新生儿重症监护室（NICU）工作，

sentences.en: so neonatal intensive care units,
sentences.zh: 也就是新生儿重症监护病房，

sentences.en: with some of the parents

sentences.en: and actually trying to help the mothers sing with their babies.
sentences.zh: 试图帮助母亲们为她们的孩子唱歌。

sentences.en: And I remember this one child who was just crying and crying,
sentences.zh: 我记得有个孩子一直在哭个不停，

sentences.en: and the mother was really struggling,
sentences.zh: 母亲感到非常吃力，

sentences.en: and you could see it was really impacting her psychologically as well.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出这对她的心理也造成了很大的影响。

sentences.en: But as soon as we started singing this lullaby,
sentences.zh: 但当我们开始唱这首摇篮曲时，

sentences.en: and she started singing along with her baby as well,
sentences.zh: 她也开始跟着一起为孩子唱歌，

sentences.en: the baby's behavior just completely changed.
sentences.zh: 孩子的行为立刻发生了彻底的改变。

sentences.en: And within a couple of minutes, it was suddenly feeding again.
sentences.zh: 几分钟之内，他突然又开始吃奶了。

sentences.en: I'm assuming that part of this might have also been
sentences.zh: 我猜想这其中部分原因可能是

sentences.en: that singing was calming the mom down,
sentences.zh: 唱歌让母亲平静了下来，

sentences.en: and perhaps that was also sending a signal to her child.
sentences.zh: 或许这也向她的孩子传递了一种信号。

sentences.en: Absolutely, and this is something that we actually saw
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样，这正是我们在不同病房中

sentences.en: so many times across different wards,
sentences.zh: 多次观察到的现象，

sentences.en: that often the parents were the ones who were the most anxious
sentences.zh: 通常家长们往往是最焦虑的，

sentences.en: and really actually struggling the most
sentences.zh: 实际上也是在他们所处的环境中

sentences.en: with the situations they were in.
sentences.zh: 挣扎得最厉害的人。

sentences.en: And actually giving them a way that they could engage
sentences.zh: 而为他们提供一种可以通过唱歌来参与、

sentences.en: and play and respond with their children through singing
sentences.zh: 互动和回应孩子的方式，

sentences.en: was something that was supporting that whole family unit together.
sentences.zh: 确实是在支持整个家庭单元。

sentences.zh: 还有一次，你看到一个烧伤的孩子正在接受治疗。

sentences.zh: 他当时正处于剧痛之中。

sentences.en: What did you observe, Daisy?
sentences.zh: 你观察到了什么，黛西？

sentences.zh: 我实际上在国家医疗服务体系（NHS）找到了一份全职工作，
